text:
tess: Heads-up: noticed small tenants lost quota headroom after last mapping change, looks like region adjustment applied twice in some paths.

omar: saw the step on per-tenant plots at ~03:12 UTC. small tenants especially.

jin: possible cause: mapper now emits region_bias and edge shaper still applies region_multiplier. merge path non-idempotent.

pat: mitigation: ops can we flip a quick override to region_multiplier=1 for affected tenants?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: applied override 'region_multiplier=1' to tenant group 'small-impacted' at 1767803225.

tess: thanks. long term we should add provenance to quota tokens and enforce single-writer semantics before combining adjustments.

omar: +1. propose quota token carry provenance list: {"provenance":["mapper"],"adjust":0.9}. merges must assert not already present.

jin: also add metric quota.merge.duplicates and alert on >0. small change but catches regressions.

pat: replay infra: can replay-bot run a 48h multi-region replay to diff behavior pre/post fix?

replay-bot: replay-bot: queued replay job #9967 (48h multi-region). ETA ~1767806800. diff CSV to /replays/9967/deltas.csv.

omar: operational plan: 1) override (done) 2) add provenance and duplicate counter 3) CI linter that flags region_multiplier in both services 4) replay + 10% canary 5) postmortem & mapping-resilience checklist. owners?

tess: I'll own #2 and #3. jin owns replay + canary. pat will handle customer comms + runbook.

jin: note: mapping should normalize detector outputs by historical quantiles so retrains don't shift scale unexpectedly. add to postmortem.

tess: agreed. we want mapping decoupled from detector scale. also consider a lightweight mapping lambda so we can A/B mapping functions without redeploying detector.

pat: will schedule 1pm sync after replay completes. thanks team.
